description: This Java class 'WebAppUtil' provides utility methods for web application management within the OFBiz framework, including handling web.xml parsing, servlet path retrieval, dispatcher and delegator setup, and security context management.

classes.name: WebAppUtil
classes.description: Utility class for web application operations in OFBiz, including web.xml parsing, servlet path retrieval, dispatcher and delegator setup, and security context management.

methods.name: getControlServletPath
methods.description: Retrieves the control servlet path based on web.xml configuration and component info.

methods.name: isDistributable
methods.description: Checks if the web application is marked as distributable in web.xml.

methods.name: getWebappInfoFromWebsiteId
methods.description: Fetches WebappInfo object associated with a given website ID.

methods.name: getWebSiteId
methods.description: Extracts the web site ID from web.xml's context parameters.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a LocalDispatcher for the web application from the servlet context.

methods.name: setAttributesFromRequestBody
methods.description: Reads JSON request body and sets parameters as request attributes.

methods.name: makeWebappDispatcher
methods.description: Creates a LocalDispatcher instance for the web application using the servlet context and delegator.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the Delegator object from the servlet context.

methods.name: getSecurity
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the Security object from the servlet context.

methods.name: getWebXml
methods.description: Loads and parses the web.xml file into a WebXml object.

methods.name: parseWebXmlFile
methods.description: Parses a web.xml file into a WebXml object, with caching.
